description: Irish index marks for vehicles first brought into use on or after 1 January 2014 — the Table to paragraph 4A of the First Schedule to S.I. No. 318 of 1992, inserted by Regulation 5(d) of S.I. No. 452 of 2013. Twenty-six marks. It differs from the earlier table (ie-index-marks) only around the three local-government amalgamations that took effect on 1 January 2014: Limerick city and county now share L (LK is gone), Waterford city and county share W (WD is gone), and the North and South Ridings of Tipperary become the single mark T (TN and TS are gone). T exists in this table only; LK, TN, TS and WD exist in the earlier one only.
